correctness.rationale: At a radius-\(R\) geodesic sphere the source normalization gives \(F=\cot R\) and \(\phi=F^2\). Standard normal-variation geometry gives \(\delta H=-\Delta f-n\csc^2R\,f\). Exact differentiation of normalized elementary symmetric functions gives \(\delta F=\delta H/n\) for every \(k\). Differentiating both integrals defining \(\phi\) shows that the area-variation terms cancel and \(\delta\phi=2\cot R\,\overline{\delta F}\). Substitution yields the claimed operator. Harmonic diagonalization then gives the stated zero modes and eigenvalues. The sign is cross-checked by the stationary radius family and by the degree-one center family, both of which must be neutral. The packaged checker replays the combinatorial derivative and spectral algebra exactly.
